change: Add snapshot columns branch_no char(3), pos_no text, district_code char(4) and posapi_instance_id uuid (FK to ebarimt.posapi_instance) to ebarimt.ebarimt_document, and include them in the trg_ebarimt_document_guard immutable tuple. Add an append-only table ebarimt.ebarimt_document_payment (tenant_id, company_id, ebarimt_document_id, line_no, code CHECK CASH/PAYMENT_CARD/BANK_TRANSFER/BANK_TRANSFER_QPAY, status CHECK PAID/PAY/REVERSED/ERROR, paid_amount platform.amount, exchange_code, data jsonb CHECK NOT fn_has_forbidden_ebarimt_keys).
reason: request_sha256 is fixed at INSERT, so the JSON must be rebuilt at dispatch without depending on master data that can change (setup, POS, payment_method). The snapshot is also needed for audit and to know which instance to check when resolving UNKNOWN. payments[] are currently not stored anywhere.

change: Add applies_to_invoice_line_no integer to sales.sales_line and sales.sales_cr_memo_line, checked for consistency with corrected_invoice_id.
reason: Partial returns must match each credit memo line exactly to an invoice line to build the corrected inactiveId receipt (NetState). Without it, matching by item and price can be ambiguous and blocks posting.

change: Add operation 'MANUAL_VOID' to ebarimt.ebarimt_document: no billIdSuffix, replaces_document_id and inactive_ddtd required, no network call. If ITC confirms that DELETE works for B2B, relax CHECK (operation <> 'DELETE' OR ebarimt_type = 'B2C_RECEIPT') to also allow B2B_RECEIPT.
reason: Full cancellation of a B2B receipt cannot use DELETE under the current CHECK. The interim workaround is a SUCCESS→CANCELLED transition with a note, which is not explicit enough.

change: Add to ebarimt.ebarimt_setup: registration_status CHECK (DRAFT/REQUESTED/AWAITING_CONFIRMATION/ACTIVE/SUSPENDED), activated_at, suspended_reason, default_classification_code char(7), expected_daily_receipts integer, invoice_flow_enabled boolean (R2), non_vat_payer_tax_type CHECK IN (NOT_VAT, VAT_FREE).
reason: Merchant registration state machine (02-architecture §9.3), default БҮНА code for G/L lines, spreading high-volume merchants across instances, and the taxType for non-VAT-payer merchants (D-E5).

change: Add a global cache table ebarimt.taxpayer_info (tin PK, found, name, vat_payer, city_payer, free_project, is_government, fetched_at).
reason: Customer TIN checks with a 30-day cache (getInfo) for the B2B decision and VAL-18. Listed as taxpayer_cache in 02-architecture but missing from the schema.

change: Seed integration.job_definition with ebarimt.info_poll (5 min), ebarimt.lease_reaper (1 min), ebarimt.overdue_check (hourly), ebarimt.reference_sync (daily), ebarimt.taxpayer_refresh, and for R2 ebarimt.purchase_import and ebarimt.sales_total_reconcile. Change the ebarimt.send_data cron from daily to every 4 hours ('0 0 */4 * * ?').
reason: Monitoring and reaper jobs required by spec §14; ADR-0013 asks for sendData every 4 hours.

change: Add to ebarimt.posapi_instance: merchant_soft_limit (default 800), receipts_per_day_soft_limit (default 70000), health_status CHECK (UP/DOWN/UNKNOWN), last_info_at, last_info_error, version. Grant app_worker UPDATE on these columns. Add a SECURITY DEFINER function ebarimt.fn_instance_merchant_counts() for worker/ops only.
reason: Instance capacity rules (ADR-0013) and the health check that stops dispatching to an instance that is down. Counting merchants across tenants needs to bypass RLS in a controlled way.

change: Add ebarimt.ebarimt_document.resent_from_document_id uuid (self FK).
reason: Link a resend clone to the document it replaces, instead of the RESENT_AS text in resolution_note.

change: Add system_line_kind text CHECK (NONE/INVOICE_ROUNDING) to sales.sales_line, sales_invoice_line and sales_cr_memo_line.
reason: Identify invoice-rounding lines reliably so they are left out of eBarimt items, instead of recognising them by G/L account.

change: Add platform.tenant_secret (same request as 13-security CR-18), plus ebarimt_setup.tpi_secret_id and ebarimt_setup.auto_confirm_imported boolean DEFAULT false (R2).
reason: Per-merchant TPI credentials or X-API-KEY for getSaleListERP, and the auto-confirm setting for imported purchase receipts.

change: Add global caches ebarimt.district (district_code PK, branch/sub-branch codes and names, fetched_at) and ebarimt.barcode_reference (barcode PK, classification_code, name, fetched_at); add classification_code.active boolean; add ebarimt_pos.district_code char(4) for companies with several branches.
reason: Cache getBranchInfo and the barcode→БҮНА lookup, keep codes that the source drops (marked inactive instead of deleted), and allow a district code per branch.

change: Add view ebarimt.v_source_document_status (company_id, source_type, source_id, ui_status, latest_document_id, ddtd, age_hours, error_code) with security_invoker = true.
reason: Read model for the eBarimt status shown on posted documents and for the unsent-receipts report (FR-EBR-013 AC2).

change: Conditional on ITC's answer (OQ-02): if billIdSuffix must be unique per PosAPI instance, add ebarimt.posapi_instance_counter with a SECURITY DEFINER allocator and a uniqueness rule per instance per day.
reason: With up to 800 merchants per instance all starting at 001000001, suffixes would collide if uniqueness is per instance.

change: Seed tax.tax_parameter with ebarimt.report_month_window_last_day = 7, ebarimt.left_lotteries_warning = 100, ebarimt.posapi_merchant_limit = 1000, ebarimt.posapi_daily_receipt_limit = 100000.
reason: D-E7: regulatory numbers must not be hard-coded.

change: Add sales.sales_header.ebarimt_pos_id uuid (FK to ebarimt.ebarimt_pos).
reason: Let the user pick the POS when a company has several; R1 uses the default POS.

change: Add ebarimt.ebarimt_document.posapi_message text.
reason: Store informational PosAPI messages on success (for example a DELETE waiting for the citizen's approval) without using error_message.

change: Add ebarimt.ebarimt_document.easy boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false (R2).
reason: Easy-registration flag (payments[].data.easy), listed as a log column in 02-architecture §9.2.

change: SCR-18: extend ebarimt.fn_ebarimt_document_guard with a status-transition whitelist: PENDING->{SENT,ERROR,CANCELLED}, SENT->{SUCCESS,ERROR,UNKNOWN}, UNKNOWN->{SUCCESS,CANCELLED}, ERROR->{CANCELLED}, SUCCESS->{CANCELLED}; on ->SENT require NEW.attempt_count = OLD.attempt_count + 1; attempt_count never decreases; PENDING only via INSERT
reason: STM-02 relied on the CHECK alone, but the current guard allows ERROR->PENDING and a ->SENT without incrementing attempt_count, so a second network send is not prevented at DB level

change: SCR-01: snapshot columns on ebarimt.ebarimt_document (branch_no char(3), pos_no text, district_code char(4), posapi_instance_id uuid FK) added to the immutable tuple in trg_ebarimt_document_guard; new append-only table ebarimt.ebarimt_document_payment (line_no, code, status, paid_amount, exchange_code, data jsonb CHECK NOT fn_has_forbidden_ebarimt_keys)
reason: Re-render the request hash independently of mutable master data (AMT-22, SET-08, MAP-12); audit; resolve UNKNOWN on the right instance

change: SCR-02: sales.sales_line.applies_to_invoice_line_no integer and sales.sales_cr_memo_line.applies_to_invoice_line_no integer (validated against corrected_invoice_id)
reason: Exact matching of credit-memo lines to invoice lines in NetState (RET-13); the heuristic can be ambiguous

change: SCR-03: allow operation 'MANUAL_VOID' on ebarimt.ebarimt_document (no billIdSuffix, requires replaces_document_id + inactive_ddtd, no network call); relax CHECK operation<>'DELETE' OR ebarimt_type='B2C_RECEIPT' for B2B if ITC allows DELETE
reason: Record B2B full cancellation (RET-51) explicitly instead of only SUCCESS->CANCELLED

change: SCR-04: ebarimt.ebarimt_setup add registration_status (DRAFT/REQUESTED/AWAITING_CONFIRMATION/ACTIVE/SUSPENDED), activated_at, suspended_reason, default_classification_code char(7), expected_daily_receipts integer, invoice_flow_enabled boolean (R2), non_vat_payer_tax_type CHECK IN (NOT_VAT, VAT_FREE)
reason: Merchant registration state (§2.3), default БҮНА code for G/L lines (MAP-31), instance load weighting (TOP-08), non-VAT-payer tax type (SET-09)

change: SCR-05: global ebarimt.taxpayer_info (tin PK, found, name, vat_payer, city_payer, free_project, is_government, fetched_at); app_worker and app_user INSERT/UPDATE
reason: 30-day getInfo cache for SET-10 and VAL-18 (02-architecture taxpayer_cache)

change: SCR-06: integration.job_definition seed: ebarimt.health_probe (PER_POSAPI_INSTANCE, '0/30 * * * * ?', max_attempts 1, timeout 5 s), ebarimt.info_poll (5 min), ebarimt.lease_reaper (1 min), ebarimt.overdue_check (1 h), ebarimt.reference_sync (daily), ebarimt.taxpayer_refresh (30 d), R2 purchase_import and sales_total_reconcile; change the ebarimt.send_data cron to '0 0 */4 * * ?'
reason: §14.1 jobs; a 5-minute poll cannot meet the 2-minute DOWN alert (MON-02); ADR-0013 calls sendData every 4 h

change: SCR-07: ebarimt.posapi_instance add merchant_soft_limit (800), receipts_per_day_soft_limit (70000), health_status (UP/DOWN/UNKNOWN), last_info_at, last_info_error, version, with app_worker UPDATE on those columns; SECURITY DEFINER ebarimt.fn_instance_merchant_counts() RETURNS TABLE(posapi_instance_id, merchants, weighted_load, expected_receipts), owner app_rls_bypass, EXECUTE granted to BOTH app_user and app_worker (aggregates only, no tenant ids)
reason: PickInstance runs in the erp-api wizard (app_user), and ebarimt_setup is under RLS (TOP-03, TOP-07, TOP-08, MON-02)

change: SCR-08: ebarimt_document.resent_from_document_id uuid (self FK)
reason: Link a clone to its cancelled original without parsing resolution_note (UNK-10)

change: SCR-09: system_line_kind text CHECK (NONE/INVOICE_ROUNDING) on sales.sales_line, sales_invoice_line, sales_cr_memo_line
reason: Identify invoice rounding lines excluded from eBarimt by a flag, not by G/L account (MAP-03)

change: SCR-10: platform.tenant_secret table; ebarimt_setup.tpi_secret_id uuid; ebarimt_setup.auto_confirm_imported boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
reason: Per-merchant TPI secrets (SEC-04); FR-PUR-009 requires auto-confirming matched imported receipts (PUR-12; OQ-14 may later flip the default)

change: SCR-11: global caches ebarimt.district (district_code PK, branch/sub-branch codes and names, fetched_at) and ebarimt.barcode_reference (barcode PK, classification_code, name, fetched_at); classification_code.active boolean DEFAULT true; ebarimt_pos.district_code char(4)
reason: getBranchInfo and barcode caches; deactivating removed codes (REF-02); multi-branch district (SET-04)

change: SCR-12: view ebarimt.v_source_document_status (company_id, source_type, source_id, chain_status, latest_document_id, ddtd, age_hours, error_code) WITH (security_invoker = true), using the §9.4 chainStatus ordering
reason: Read model for posted documents and the 'unsent receipts' report (FR-EBR-013 AC2), aligned with the API EbarimtChainStatus

change: SCR-13 (conditional on OQ-02): ebarimt.posapi_instance_counter (posapi_instance_id, last_seq) with a SECURITY DEFINER allocator, and ebarimt_document UNIQUE per instance + day
reason: If billIdSuffix must be unique per PosAPI instance per day rather than per POS (BIL-07)

change: SCR-14: tax.tax_parameter seed ebarimt.report_month_window_last_day=7, ebarimt.left_lotteries_warning=100, ebarimt.posapi_merchant_limit=1000, ebarimt.posapi_daily_receipt_limit=100000, with status='verified', legal_basis='PosAPI 3.0 v3.2.48', source_url=developer.itc.gov.mn
reason: D-E7 keeps statutory numbers out of code; unverified rows must not drive postings, and the reportMonth window blocks posting

change: SCR-15: sales.sales_header.ebarimt_pos_id uuid FK to ebarimt.ebarimt_pos
reason: Let users pick the POS in multi-POS companies

change: SCR-16: ebarimt_document.posapi_message text
reason: Keep informational PosAPI messages (e.g. DELETE pending citizen approval) separate from error_message

change: SCR-17: ebarimt_document.easy boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false (R2)
reason: Easy-register flag (02-architecture §9.2 log column)

change: SCR-19: purchase.purchase_header.supplier_ebarimt_date timestamptz and snapshot purchase.purch_inv_header.supplier_ebarimt_date timestamptz
reason: ebarimt.purchase_receipt.receipt_date is NOT NULL but manual R1 entry had no source (PUR-03); needed for the 'date <= posting date' check (PUR-02)

change: SCR-20: inv.item_unit_of_measure.barcode_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNDEFINED' CHECK (barcode_type IN ('GS1','ISBN','UNDEFINED'))
reason: The barCodeType of a unit-of-measure barcode is currently derived by guesswork (§5.4)

change: SCR-21: ebarimt_none_reason text CHECK IN ('USER_OVERRIDE','CUSTOMER_DEFAULT','EXTERNAL_ISSUER','WINDOW_CLOSED_OVERRIDE','CHAIN_CANCELLED') on sales.sales_invoice_header and sales.sales_cr_memo_header, with CHECK ((ebarimt_receipt_type = 'NONE') = (ebarimt_none_reason IS NOT NULL))
reason: The 'sales without eBarimt' compliance report (TYP-03, CMP-037) needs a reliable reason for NONE (TYP-07, RET-62)

change: CR-01: Attach audit.fn_row_change triggers to platform.user_company_role, platform.permission, platform.permission_set_include, platform.role_permission_set (or add row_version/updated_at/updated_by so the 140 auto-attach loop covers them).
reason: These security link tables have no row_version, so role assignments and permission edits are not change-logged. Violates BC R-PLATFORM-SECURITY-API-10, FR-PLT-009, NFR-051, SEC-AZ-13.

change: CR-02: Add platform.user_company_role.expires_at timestamptz NULL with CHECK (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > created_at); index (tenant_id, user_id).
reason: FR-PLT-005 requires optional time limits for External accountant (SEC-ID-07); the permission resolver filters on it.

change: CR-03: Add an 'identity' schema (add to the D-B3/D-K1 list), tenant-less with no RLS and DML only for app_user. Tables: user_credential (password hash, security stamp, lockout, protected TOTP secret, last TOTP step, hashed recovery codes), user_session (sid hash, encrypted ticket, amr, auth_time, recent_auth_at, tenant_id, expiry), the OpenIddict tables (oidc_application/authorization/scope/token), data_protection_key, one_time_token (hashed).
reason: ADR-0016 and 02 §4.2.1/§10.1 need an Identity/OpenIddict store and a BFF session store; login happens before a tenant context exists (SEC-RLS-06). The canonical DDL has none of these tables.

change: CR-04: SECURITY DEFINER functions owned by app_rls_bypass, EXECUTE for app_user, search_path pinned: platform.fn_list_user_tenants(p_user_id uuid) RETURNS (tenant_id, name, tenant_status, membership_status); platform.fn_find_invitation(p_token_hash bytea); platform.fn_accept_invitation(p_token_hash bytea, p_user_id uuid).
reason: tenant_membership is isolated per tenant by fail-closed RLS, so a logged-in user's tenants cannot be listed and invitations cannot be accepted without these functions (§5.5, §4.7).

change: CR-05: New table platform.tenant_invitation (id, tenant_id, email lower-case, role_id, company_id NULL, token_hash bytea(32) UNIQUE, expires_at, invited_by, accepted_at, accepted_user_id, revoked_at, created_at, row_version), with tenant RLS and audit.
reason: tenant_membership.user_id is NOT NULL and references app_user, so an email with no account cannot be invited (SEC-ID-08).

change: CR-06: Add to party.customer and party.vendor: personal_id_enc bytea, personal_id_hmac bytea(32), personal_id_hint text, personal_tin_enc bytea, personal_tin_hmac bytea(32), personal_tin_hint text. Add CHECK (kind <> 'INDIVIDUAL' OR (registration_no IS NULL AND tin IS NULL)), and for vendor also ebarimt_merchant_tin IS NULL. Index (company_id, *_hmac). On posted snapshot columns sales_invoice_header/sales_cr_memo_header.customer_registration_no add CHECK value !~ '^[А-ЯЁӨҮ]{2}[0-9]{8}$'; on customer_tin/vendor_tin of sales and purchase posted headers add CHECK value !~ '^[0-9]{12,14}$'. On bank.posted_cash_voucher.counterparty_id_doc add CHECK (counterparty_id_doc IS NULL OR counterparty_id_doc LIKE 'enc:v1:%').
reason: ADR-0023 D, 02 §10.5, FR-PTY-004 and NFR-033 require app-level encryption of citizen registration numbers and individuals' civil_id. The schema stores them as plaintext (SEC-PII-03/04).

change: CR-07: New table platform.tenant_key (id, tenant_id, purpose IN ('PII_ENC','PII_HMAC','SECRET_ENC'), version, wrapped_key bytea, kek_id, algorithm, created_at, retired_at, UNIQUE (tenant_id, purpose, version)) with tenant RLS. app_user: SELECT and INSERT; UPDATE only on wrapped_key, kek_id, retired_at (rewrap); DELETE only during purge.
reason: Per-tenant data keys for envelope encryption of PII-S, KEK rotation by rewrap, and crypto-shredding on purge (§10.6, §11.3, §12.5).

change: CR-23: Changes to seed db/seed/mn_00_catalogs.sql §4. New assignable sets: ERP_SALES_RETURN, ERP_SALES_ANY, ERP_ARCHIVE, ERP_DOC_SIGN, ERP_DOC_APPROVE, ERP_TENANT_ADMIN. New non-assignable sets: ERP_SUPER (wildcards plus protected objects by name), ERP_SUPPORT_READ, ERP_SUPPORT_WRITE, ERP_SYSTEM_JOB. Move sales.creditmemo.post and sales.invoice.cancel out of ERP_SALES_POST. Move audit.security_event R from ERP_AUDIT_READ to ERP_SECURITY and add audit.security_incident R. ERP_EBARIMT_OPS ebarimt_document RM -> Rm. New actions: platform.pii.anonymize, sales.document.send, purchase.invoice.cancel, party.ledger_entry.edit, ebarimt.send_data.trigger, audit.export, platform.attachment.add. Add aging, VAT, daily_sales and navigate reports to ERP_FIN_REPORTS. Add a function platform.fn_seed_builtin_roles(tenant) that creates OWNER, ACCOUNTANT, EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTANT, SALES_CLERK, VIEWER with the §6.5 set mapping.
reason: Needed for the normative role matrix (§6.6, SEC-T-01): Sales clerk cannot post credit memos, Accountant cannot read the security log, Owner gets all rights via wildcard without per-tenant migrations, support access is restricted. No built-in role seed exists today.

change: CR-08: New table platform.integration_client (id = service principal, tenant_id, company_id NULL, name, oidc_client_id UNIQUE, permission_set_id, expires_at, revoked_at, revoked_by, last_used_at, created_at/by, row_version) with tenant RLS and audit.
reason: FR-INT-003 client_credentials clients scoped to a tenant, optional company and a permission set (§5.9).

change: CR-09: (a) Seed a system principal row in platform.app_user: id 00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001, email system@erp.invalid. (b) New tenant-less table platform.platform_operator (user_id PK, role IN ('SUPPORT','SECURITY_ADMIN','DBA'), active, created_at/by); SELECT for app_user, writes by migrator/ops only.
reason: audit changed_by and created_by are uuid, so system jobs need a fixed principal (SEC-JOB-03). Support engineers must be identifiable (SEC-RLS-11).

change: CR-10: In production remove business-table SELECT from app_readonly (erp_ops_ro) and grant SELECT only on PII-free aggregate ops views.
reason: app.tenant_id is settable by any client, so the current GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES to app_readonly lets ops read every tenant (SEC-RLS-08, 02 §7.5).

change: CR-11: Column-level grants. platform.tenant: revoke app_user UPDATE on status, plan_code, max_companies; add SECURITY DEFINER platform.fn_set_tenant_status for platform operators. platform.app_user: app_user may UPDATE only display_name, phone, preferred_language, last_login_at, updated_*; add last_login_at to the audit trigger's ignore list.
reason: The tenant_self and app_user_self_update policies currently let a tenant reactivate itself (SUSPENDED -> ACTIVE) and let a user change their own status or MFA flag (§7.8, SEC-ID-11, SEC-AUD-07).

change: CR-12: New table platform.archive_package (id, tenant_id, company_id, fiscal_year, version, status, manifest_sha256 bytea(32), object_prefix, file_count, total_bytes, retain_until, generated_at/by, verified_at, verification_status), registered in ledger_guard with only the verification columns mutable.
reason: FR-RPT-017 annual archive with a SHA-256 manifest and periodic verification (SEC-RET-06..09).

change: CR-13: New append-only table platform.document_rendition (id, tenant_id, company_id, document_table, document_id, document_no, template_code, template_version, sha256 bytea(32), object_key, byte_size, created_at/by, UNIQUE (company_id, document_table, document_id, template_version)).
reason: Signatures must point to a stored, immutable canonical PDF; a re-rendered PDF changes the hash (§15.3).

change: CR-14: New table platform.company_signatory (id, tenant_id, company_id, signer_role IN ('DIRECTOR','CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT','CASHIER'), user_id, valid_from, valid_to, row_version) with an EXCLUDE constraint against overlapping periods; audited.
reason: REQ-ACC-01 and SEC-SIG-04: only designated people may sign as director or chief accountant.

change: CR-15: Add hash_version smallint, prev_hash bytea(32), hash bytea(32) to gl.gl_register (append-only).
reason: FR-GL-028, NFR-053, 02 §8.7 hash chain and Order 47 'cannot conceal or alter' evidence; the columns are missing from the canonical schema.

change: CR-16: integration.fn_purge_expired(p_kind, p_before, p_limit) RETURNS integer, SECURITY DEFINER owned by app_rls_bypass, EXECUTE for app_worker, with an allow-list: idempotency keys 7 days, outbox/inbox 30 days, job_run 90 days.
reason: The seeded SYSTEM job integration.cleanup cannot delete across tenants under fail-closed RLS (SEC-JOB-07).

change: CR-22: New table platform.attachment (id, tenant_id, company_id, owner_table, owner_id, file_name, media_type, byte_size, sha256, object_key, av_status IN ('PENDING','CLEAN','INFECTED'), created_at/by); append-only for posted documents.
reason: FR-PLT-011 attachments, ASVS V5 file handling, and 02 §4.2.1 lists the table but the schema lacks it.

change: CR-17: New tenant-less append-only table platform.tenant_purge_log (tenant_id, purged_at, operator_ids, ticket, row_counts). Add a purge branch to platform.fn_guard_immutable allowing DELETE only when the current user is the owner, current_setting('erp.purge_tenant') equals OLD.tenant_id, and the tenant status is PURGE_APPROVED.
reason: 02 §7.7/§8.1 describe a tenant purge, but the current guard makes purge impossible without disabling triggers (§12.5).

change: CR-18: New table platform.tenant_secret (id, tenant_id, company_id NULL, kind, ciphertext, key_version, last4, created_at, rotated_at, row_version), envelope-encrypted.
reason: Third-party credentials for R2/R3 bank APIs and QPay (02 §10.4, SEC-KEY-02).

change: CR-19: Add to platform.tenant: require_mfa_all_users boolean default false, legal_hold_until date NULL, retention_years_override smallint NULL CHECK (>= 10).
reason: Tenant-wide MFA policy (R2), legal hold (SEC-RET-03), retention override (SEC-RET-04).

change: CR-20 (R3): SECURITY DEFINER function to anonymize personal data in posted-document snapshots (customer_name, customer_address, customer_registration_no, ebarimt_consumer_no) only for rows with posting_date before the retention horizon, with a dedicated ledger_guard allowance.
reason: Personal-data law minimisation for tenants that stay active for more than 10 years (§10.8, Q2).

change: CR-21: audit.fn_purge_expired(p_table, p_cutoff, p_limit) RETURNS integer, SECURITY DEFINER, run in tenant/company context, allow-list: audit.row_change, audit.security_event, audit.posting_log, ebarimt.ebarimt_document_event.
reason: app_user and app_worker have no DELETE on audit tables; needed for the 10-year retention purge (§12.4).

change: CR-21 (extended): add audit.fn_purge_expired(text, timestamptz, integer), SECURITY DEFINER owned by app_owner, EXECUTE for app_worker, limited to an allow-list of audit tables. Also add audit.fn_purge_platform_rows(timestamptz, integer), owned by app_rls_bypass, that deletes only audit.security_event rows with tenant_id IS NULL and audit.row_change rows with the nil tenant id once they are past the 10-year cutoff.
reason: app_user and app_worker cannot DELETE from audit tables, and rows with no tenant cannot be seen under RLS, so nothing currently purges them at 10 years (SEC-RET-11, §12.4).

change: CR-23 (7), a seed change: fix platform.fn_mn_seed_roles() in db/seed/mn_60_security.sql. OWNER gets only ERP_SUPER instead of '*'. Remove ERP_PII_UNMASK from ACCOUNTANT and EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTANT and add ERP_SALES_RETURN, ERP_SALES_ANY, ERP_ARCHIVE and ERP_DOC_APPROVE. Add ERP_DOC_SIGN to SALES_CLERK. Fix the role rows of already-provisioned tenants with a migration.
reason: The current mapping conflicts with FR-PTY-004 (unmask only for Owner by default). '*' would also give OWNER the new non-assignable sets, which breaks SEC-AZ-10.

change: CR-23 (8), a seed change: add ACTION objects sales.document.print (ERP_SALES_POST), gl.journal.preview (ERP_JOURNALS_EDIT), purchase.document.preview (ERP_PURCH_EDIT) and ebarimt.document.override. The last one goes in a new set ERP_EBARIMT_OVERRIDE that no built-in role receives.
reason: Specs 05, 12, 14, 15 and the OpenAPI file already use these objects, but they are missing from the seed catalog.

change: CR-23 (9), a seed change: set ERP_PERIOD_REOPEN.assignable = false.
reason: D-D3 says only the Owner may reopen a closed period. An assignable set lets a custom role get around that.

change: SCR-FA-01: fa.depreciation_run — add gl_integrated boolean NOT NULL (a snapshot of the book type taken at creation). Replace CHECK (status='DRAFT' OR transaction_no IS NOT NULL OR status='REVERSED') with CHECK (status<>'POSTED' OR NOT gl_integrated OR transaction_no IS NOT NULL). Add calculated_at, calculated_max_fa_entry_no bigint, total_amount platform.amount, posted_at/posted_by, reversal_transaction_no (FK to gl_transaction), reversed_at/reversed_by. Add CHECK posting_date = period_ending_date and CHECK that period_ending_date is a month end.
reason: A TAX memo book run never creates a G/L voucher, so the current CHECK makes POSTED impossible for TAX runs (FR-FA-008). Runs also need a document number and data to detect a stale draft (spec S11-05).

UNIQUE (company_id, run, fixed_asset_id); FK indexes; RLS. A trigger blocks UPDATE/DELETE when the run is not DRAFT.
reason: Supports the draft, preview, post flow of the depreciation run and lets the user see why skipped assets were skipped (R-FA-INVENTORY-02/28).

change: SCR-FA-03: extend gl.fn_ledger_transaction_check() so that rows with transaction_no NULL in fa.fa_ledger_entry, inv.item_ledger_entry and inv.value_entry call gl.fn_assert_posting_date_allowed(company, posting_date, false). change: SCR-INV-01: add (1) inv.item_journal draft header: journal_type ADJUSTMENT/OPENING/PHYS_COUNT, posting_date, reason_code_id, location_id, bal_gl_account_id (required only for OPENING), status OPEN/COUNTING, calculated_at, calculated_max_ile_entry_no, blind_count, row_version. change: SCR-FA-04: add views/functions in 920_views.sql: fa.fn_fa_book_values(as_of, book), fa.v_fa_gl_reconciliation, fa.fn_fa_book_tax_difference(year), inv.fn_inventory_valuation(as_of), inv.v_item_cost_state_check, inv.v_inventory_gl_reconciliation (all security_invoker).

change: SCR-FA-05 (seed mn_40_setup.sql): add gapless yearly number series DP (Элэгдлийн ваучер), IA (Бараа материалын тохируулгын баримт), IC (Тооллогын баримт) and draft series IA_DRAFT, IC_DRAFT. change: MODIFIED SCR-FA-03: (1) in gl.fn_ledger_transaction_check, call gl.fn_assert_posting_date_allowed when transaction_no IS NULL for fa.fa_ledger_entry, inv.item_ledger_entry and inv.value_entry. (2) Add CHECK on fa.fa_ledger_entry: fa_posting_date = posting_date OR (source_code='OPENING' AND fa_posting_date <= posting_date AND fa_posting_type IN ('ACQUISITION_COST','DEPRECIATION')) OR (source_code='REVERSAL' AND reversed_entry_no IS NOT NULL).
reason: The TAX run and zero-cost inventory documents have no G/L voucher, so nothing stops them posting into a closed period. The REVERSAL clause is new: without it the CHECK would reject reversals of opening-balance entries, which keep the original fa_posting_date.

change: rpt.fn_trial_balance(p_from, p_to, p_include_closing): when p_include_closing = false, exclude only the closing entries of the report period's fiscal year end. Always include earlier years' closing entries (posting_date < p_from) in opening balances.

change: Add platform.fn_integrity_report(p_company uuid DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS TABLE(check_code text, status text, details jsonb): SECURITY INVOKER, read-only. change: CR-PST-04: add platform.number_series.yearly_prefix_pattern text NULL (for example 'SI-{YYYY}-') so the number allocator can create the new year's number_series_line on first use
reason: FR-PLT-008 AC3 requires numbering to restart at 00001 automatically each year; today a missing yearly line raises ERN01 (Z-PST-12).

change: gl.journal_line.system_origin text NULL CHECK (system_origin ~ '^[A-Z_]+:[0-9A-Za-z_-]+$') + index (company_id, journal_batch_id, system_origin) WHERE system_origin IS NOT NULL (CR-PST-05)
reason: BR-PST-58 identifies the retained-earnings re-transfer draft lines by the free-text comment marker; if a user edits the comment, the proposal is duplicated. A system-origin column marks them reliably.

change: 910_ledger_guards.sql gl.fn_assert_posting_date_allowed: a separate SQLSTATE per reason (ERP01 no period, ERP03 period/year not OPEN, ERP04 LOCKED, ERP05 outside company window), or a machine-readable reason in DETAIL (CR-PST-06)
reason: Today every case raises ERP01, so the app must re-query to choose gl.period_not_found / gl.period_closed / gl.period_locked / gl.posting_date_outside_window (§8.8).

change: Unchanged and still open: CR-PST-01 gl.gl_transaction.corrects_transaction_no + gl.journal_line.corrects_transaction_no; CR-PST-02 gl.gl_register hash_version/prev_hash/hash (13 CR-15); CR-PST-03 date_order=false for the GJ/BR/BP/OB/CL seed series; CR-PST-04 number_series.yearly_prefix_pattern with automatic creation of the yearly line
reason: FR-GL-014 link from a correction to its original transaction; FR-GL-028 hash chain; ERN02 when journal or re-transfer vouchers are back-dated (the risk is now documented in BR-PST-58 and E-I); FR-PLT-008 AC3

change: SCR-SAL-01: Add `allow_invoice_disc boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true` to sales.sales_line, sales.sales_invoice_line and sales.sales_cr_memo_line
reason: The R2 invoice discount (BR-SAL invoice discount rules, §6) has to leave out lines such as services or fees. BC has the field, but the schema has no per-line flag.

change: SCR-SAL-02: Add `party.fn_customer_aging(p_as_of date, p_aging_bucket_set_id uuid DEFAULT NULL, p_customer_id uuid DEFAULT NULL)`, plus a matching vendor function, that computes aging from detailed_cust_ledger_entry as of a given date
reason: The aging API takes a date and a bucket-set id (D-F7). The function has to be built from the detailed entries so that past as-of dates are correct (§5 aging SQL, P11).

change: SCR-SAL-03: Add a published read model for the customer statement: `party.fn_customer_statement(p_customer_id uuid, p_from date, p_to date)` or the view `party.v_cust_ledger_movement` (opening balance, movements, closing balance)
reason: Reporting may read only published views and functions (02 §4.3). FR-RPT-003 needs a statement, and no published read model exists yet (P12).

change: SCR-SAL-04: Make `platform.fn_ledger_update` write an `audit.row_change` row for every whitelisted update to a ledger (due date, on_hold, payment terms fields)
reason: FR-PTY-014 AC1 and D-I3 require an audit trail for edits after posting. Today fn_ledger_update changes ledger rows without leaving an audit record.

change: SCR-SAL-05: Define what `detailed_cust_ledger_entry.initial_entry_due_date` means: either add a COMMENT saying it is fixed at posting time, or allow fn_ledger_update to change it when the due date is edited
reason: Aging is computed from the detailed entries. After a due-date edit it is unclear whether to use the original due date or the current one (BR-AR due-date edit rules).

change: SCR-SAL-06: Add `bal_account_type`, `bal_account_id` and `payment_transaction_no` to sales.sales_invoice_header and sales.sales_cr_memo_header
reason: The cash-sale payment voucher has to be found from, and reprinted from, the posted document. Today the link to the balancing payment-method account and its G/L transaction is lost after posting.

change: SCR-SAL-07: Add a daily job_definition `party.application_draft.cleanup` that deletes abandoned application_draft worksheets
reason: Application drafts are temporary worksheet rows per user (§5 application worksheet). Without cleanup, abandoned drafts pile up and leave stale sets of marked entries.

change: SCR-SAL-08: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_cust_ledger_entry__doc_no ON party.cust_ledger_entry (company_id, document_type, document_no) WHERE document_type IN ('INVOICE','CREDIT_MEMO')
reason: BR-AR-09 / R-SALES-DOCUMENTS-38 (a MUST rule) is only an app-side check. The index enforces document-number uniqueness in the database, which also covers opening-balance imports and other writers. The vendor side already has ux_vendor_ledger_entry__vendor_doc_no.

change: SCR-SAL-09: party.application_draft.updated_at DEFAULT now() (or NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
reason: The BR-AR-36 rule that releases a stale application draft after 30 minutes reads updated_at, which is NULL right after INSERT. Until this changes, the app uses coalesce(updated_at, created_at).

change: Implement eBarimt spec SCR-09 before enabling invoice rounding: system_line_kind text CHECK (NONE/INVOICE_ROUNDING) on sales.sales_line, sales_invoice_line and sales_cr_memo_line
reason: The rounding line must be identified by a flag rather than by its account, so that it stays out of VAT and posting-buffer processing, is copied correctly on cancellation (BR-SAL-73/74) and is skipped by :copy. FR-SAL-013 (invoice rounding) cannot be enabled without it.

change: SCR-PUR-01: add non_deductible_reason text CHECK IN ('NON_VAT_COMPANY','SIMPLIFIED_REGIME','REJECTED','PASSENGER_CAR','PERSONAL_USE','EXEMPT_RELATED','NO_EBARIMT') to purchase.purchase_line and purchase.purch_inv_line (purch_cr_memo_line via LIKE). This is the same change as 08 CR-TAX-02 and should ship as one migration.
reason: FR-TAX-010 requires a reason for non-deductible VAT. Without the column the non-deductible amount cannot be rebuilt when a draft is recalculated, and there is no audit trail. It is a prerequisite for BR-PUR-46 NON_DEDUCTIBLE and for the 1:1 copy when cancelling (BR-PUR-89).

change: SCR-PUR-02: add ebarimt.purchase_receipt.purch_cr_memo_header_id uuid (FK purchase.purch_cr_memo_header) with CHECK that it and purch_inv_header_id are not both set; or add a partial UNIQUE index on purchase.purch_cr_memo_header (company_id, supplier_ebarimt_id).
reason: Lets the supplier's return/correction ДДТД be registered and its uniqueness enforced in the database (BR-PUR-43, §5.14).

change: SCR-PUR-03: add gl.journal_line.recipient_bank_account_id uuid (FK party.vendor_bank_account, same vendor).
reason: Holds the payee bank account for payment journal lines, payment orders and the R3 bank API (BR-AP-67).

change: SCR-PUR-04: add to party.application_draft: owner_kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SESSION' CHECK IN ('SESSION','JOURNAL_LINE'), journal_line_id uuid FK gl.journal_line ON DELETE CASCADE, and CHECK ((owner_kind='JOURNAL_LINE') = (journal_line_id IS NOT NULL)).
reason: Allocation drafts created for summarized suggested-payment lines must be deleted with their journal line and must not be swept by the 30-minute session cleanup (BR-AP-34, 75, 78). Today this relies on a 'JNL:' prefix and app-side deletes.

change: SCR-PUR-05: CREATE INDEX ix_journal_line__applies_to ON gl.journal_line (company_id, account_type, account_id, applies_to_doc_type, applies_to_doc_no) WHERE applies_to_doc_no IS NOT NULL.
reason: Payment suggestion must skip entries already targeted by any journal batch (Z-PUR-08, BR-AP-72).

change: SCR-PUR-06: add CHECK (VALUE = upper(btrim(VALUE))) to the platform.ext_document_no domain, or add platform.fn_normalize_ext_doc_no plus a BEFORE INSERT normalisation on party.vendor_ledger_entry.
reason: Other write paths (journals, imports) can bypass app normalisation and so defeat ux_vendor_ledger_entry__vendor_doc_no through case or whitespace differences (BR-PUR-10, 12).

change: SCR-PUR-07 (R2): add customs_declaration_no text and customs_value numeric(19,4) to purchase.purchase_header and purch_inv_header; add tax.vat_entry.customs_declaration_no (whitelisted for updates).
reason: FULL_VAT customs VAT needs evidence before it can be confirmed, and the ТТ-03а return needs the import VAT base (BR-PUR-47, P14, OQ-PUR-03).

change: SCR-PUR-08: add payment_transaction_no bigint (FK gl.gl_transaction, DEFERRABLE) to purchase.purch_inv_header and purch_cr_memo_header.
reason: Lets the cash-purchase payment voucher and МХ-2 be found and reprinted directly from the posted document (mirror of SCR-SAL-06).

change: SCR-PUR-09: seed gl.general_ledger_setup.max_vat_difference_allowed = 1.00 (currently 0), or ask for it in the setup wizard.
reason: purchase_setup.allow_vat_difference is seeded true but the 0 limit blocks the VAT-difference feature of FR-PUR-003 (BR-PUR-33, P1a).

change: SCR-PUR-11: add 'INPUT_VAT_WRITE_OFF' to the audit.posting_log.posting_type CHECK.
reason: Gives the input VAT write-off (§5.12) its own posting-log type; until then it uses GENERAL_JOURNAL.

change: SCR-PUR-12 (only if OQ-PUR-07 is answered yes): add party.vendor_ledger_entry.cancelled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false (whitelisted) and add AND NOT cancelled to ux_vendor_ledger_entry__vendor_doc_no.
reason: Would allow a cancelled invoice's vendor invoice no. to be reused on the corrective invoice (BR-PUR-14).

change: SCR-PUR-13: add REPORT object rpt.vendor_statement to the seed catalog (ERP_FIN_REPORTS, ERP_PAYABLES) and add party.fn_vendor_statement(p_vendor_id uuid, p_from date, p_to date) (mirror of SCR-SAL-03).

change: SCR-PUR-14: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_vendor_ledger_entry__doc_no ON party.vendor_ledger_entry (company_id, document_type, document_no) WHERE document_type IN ('INVOICE','CREDIT_MEMO') AND source_code <> 'OPENING'

The cash-purchase PAYMENT/REFUND VLE shares the document number but has a different type, so it does not conflict. change: SCR-BNK-01: new table bank.counterparty_account_map (tenant_id, company_id, account_no_norm, party_type CUSTOMER/VENDOR, party_id, source LEARNED/MANUAL, times_confirmed, last_seen_at, row_version; UNIQUE (company_id, account_no_norm, party_type, party_id); index (company_id, account_no_norm); RLS). Learned when a reconciliation is posted (BR-BNK-72).
reason: The schema has no customer bank account table, so the statement counterparty account cannot identify a customer as FULLY. GS-REC-001 L1 (HIGH via account + document no + amount) depends on it; without it most receipts drop to MEDIUM and need manual approval.

change: SCR-FX-01: add exchange_rate platform.exch_rate (MNT per 1 FCY) to gl.journal_line, sales.sales_header, sales.sales_invoice_header, sales.sales_cr_memo_header, purchase.purchase_header, purchase.purch_inv_header, purchase.purch_cr_memo_header. Add original_exchange_rate and whitelisted adjusted_exchange_rate to party.cust_ledger_entry and party.vendor_ledger_entry. CHECKs: currency_code IS NULL = exchange_rate IS NULL; currency_factor = round(1/exchange_rate, 18).
reason: Converting via currency_factor (numeric(38,18)) rounds midpoints the wrong way: 10.01 × 3,450.50 = 34,539.505 gives 34,539.50, but FR-FX-004 AC1 and GS-FX-001 expect 34,539.51. The interim RateOf(f) = Round(1/f, 6) is exact only for rates with ≤ 6 decimals, not for user-overridden rates.

change: SCR-BNK-02: add undone_at timestamptz, undone_by uuid, undo_reason_code_id uuid to bank.bank_account_statement; register them as mutable_columns in platform.ledger_guard; replace UNIQUE (company_id, bank_account_id, statement_no) with a partial unique index WHERE undone_at IS NULL.
reason: The append-only snapshot has no way to record that a posted statement was undone (FR-BNK-014), and re-posting the same statement number would violate the unique constraint.

change: SCR-BNK-03: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX on bank.bank_account (company_id, bank_account_posting_group_id) and on bank.bank_account_posting_group (company_id, gl_account_id).
reason: Enforce 'one G/L account = one money account' (FR-BNK-001 AC2, BR-BNK-02) and the subledger = G/L invariant (BR-BNK-14) at DB level.

change: SCR-FX-02: add gl.general_ledger_setup.bank_reval_gain_loss_kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'REALIZED' CHECK IN ('REALIZED','UNREALIZED').
reason: Revaluation of FX money accounts posts to the realized account by default (BC, FR-FX-009, GS-FX-005), but the MN accounting/tax treatment is open (⚠). This makes it configurable without code changes.

change: SCR-BNK-04: add bank.bank_reconciliation_line.parent_line_no integer (CHECK parent_line_no < statement_line_no).
reason: Explicitly link a split difference child line to its parent (BR-BNK-62, R-BANK-CASH-30); today the only link is a shared bank_statement_line_id.

change: SCR-BNK-05: relax the bank_ledger_entry CHECK (statement_status = 'OPEN' OR statement_no IS NOT NULL) to also allow amount = 0.
reason: Zero-amount revaluation entries could then be written as CLOSED like in BC (R-BANK-CASH-04); currently they are written as OPEN with open = false (BR-BNK-79), which is semantically unclear.

change: SCR-BNK-06: add bank_reconciliation_id to bank.bank_rec_match_member with UNIQUE (company_id, bank_reconciliation_id, bank_ledger_entry_no) WHERE bank_ledger_entry_no IS NOT NULL.
reason: Prevent one bank ledger entry from being in two match groups of the same reconciliation at DB level (BR-BNK-64); today this is only an app check.

change: SCR-FX-03: add revision smallint and superseded_at timestamptz to fx.official_exchange_rate, with UNIQUE (source, currency_code, rate_date, revision) — or formally accept UPDATE plus audit.row_change.
reason: 02-architecture §9.5 says Mongolbank corrections are append-only new rows, but the schema UNIQUE (source, currency_code, rate_date) forces an UPDATE (BR-FX-14).

change: SCR-FX-04 (seed, mn_40_setup.sql / 140 job seed): add number series FXA 'Ханшийн тэгшитгэлийн ваучер' (gapless, reset_yearly, FXA-YYYY-#####); change fx.mongolbank_rates cron to weekdays '0 15 2 ? * MON-FRI' (10:15 Ulaanbaatar).
reason: Revaluation vouchers need a gapless legal series (D-C7, BR-FX-52). Mongolbank publishes on weekday mornings; retries are handled by max_attempts = 5 (BR-FX-10).

change: SCR-BNK-07 (seed, mn_00_catalogs.sql): permission object ACTION fx.exch_rate_adjustment.post in PERIOD_CLOSE; add fx.currency_exchange_rate, bank.bank_statement_import_format and bank.text_to_account_mapping to T_SETUP; confirm bank.statement.import and bank.reconciliation.post exist.
reason: The new and confirmed endpoints in §10.3 need permission objects (aligns with 14 SCR-API-08).

change: Seed (mn_40_setup.sql fn_mn_ensure_number_series): set date_order = false on the BR and BP number series, or give reconciliation its own BR/BP batch series (SCR-BNK-08)
reason: Reconciliation vouchers are dated by bank transaction_date. With date_order = true, any statement line dated before the last BR/BP number (e.g. a mid-month POST /payments) fails with ERN02, which blocks the core R1 'Post and reconcile' flow (BR-BNK-81). D-C7 is flagged and needs accountant confirmation.

change: fx.exch_rate_adjmt_register: add reverses_run_no bigint NULL (reversal rows point to the run they reverse), CHECK reverses_run_no IS NULL OR reverses_run_no < run_no, index (company_id, currency_code, run_no) (SCR-FX-05)
reason: The append-only register has no way to mark a run as reversed. Without it, BR-FX-54 cannot find the latest non-reversed run, restore adjusted_currency_factor and last_date_adjusted, or apply BR-FX-41 reliably.

change: Extend SCR-BNK-02: besides undone_at, undone_by and undo_reason_code_id, add a SECURITY DEFINER function bank.fn_mark_account_statement_undone(p_id uuid, p_reason uuid) that updates only the undone_* columns while undone_at IS NULL, allowed through fn_guard_immutable; make UNIQUE (company_id, bank_account_id, statement_no) a partial unique index WHERE undone_at IS NULL
reason: bank.bank_account_statement is in ledger_guard with key_column = NULL (no bigint key), so platform.fn_ledger_update(p_key bigint) cannot mark a snapshot as undone. Re-posting an undone statement number also breaks the UNIQUE constraint.

change: Extend SCR-FX-04 (seed): create the FXA number series with date_order = false (in addition to gapless, reset_yearly, FXA-YYYY-#####) and set the weekday 10:15 UB cron for fx.mongolbank_rates
reason: A late revaluation run (BR-FX-49) creates vouchers dated d_k, which can fall after the D of the next run. With date_order = true the next run would fail with ERN02.

change: SCR-RPT-01: Replace rpt.fn_trial_balance(p_from, p_to, p_include_closing, p_dim1 uuid DEFAULT NULL, p_dim2 uuid DEFAULT NULL) in 920_views.sql. New rule: the opening balance is the sum of all entries dated before p_from, which includes earlier closing entries. p_include_closing only controls the closing entries dated p_to. Income-statement accounts are no longer truncated at the fiscal-year start. Add global-dimension filters (SQL in spec §5.9).
reason: BR-RPT-11, Z-RPT-09. Today's function breaks the opening-balance totals when the prior year is not closed, and shows 3500 wrongly after the close (16 SCR-T01, seed README §12 #9, GS-CLOSE-004).

change: SCR-RPT-02: New append-only table rpt.filing_submission. Columns: id, tenant_id, company_id, fiscal_year_id (FK to gl.fiscal_year), filing_type CHECK IN ('EBALANCE_ANNUAL','EBALANCE_HALFYEAR'), submitted_at date, submitted_by, submission_reference, evidence_attachment_id (FK after 13 CR-22), evidence_note, snapshot_ids uuid[]. UNIQUE (company_id, fiscal_year_id, filing_type); CHECK that either an evidence attachment or a note of at least 10 characters exists. Add RLS and a ledger_guard entry.
reason: BR-PER-17 and BR-EBL-10. FR-GL-024 says LOCKED means submission evidence is stored (REQ-ACC-12). The reporting.filing_submission table named in 02 §9.6 does not exist in the schema.

change: SCR-RPT-03: New table rpt.statement_snapshot. Columns: id, tenant_id, company_id, financial_report_id, report_code CHECK IN (SBT, ODT, OOT, MGT, TB, EBALANCE), fiscal_year, date_from, date_to, parameters jsonb, definition_sha256, statement_line_version, result jsonb, result_sha256, pdf_object_key, pdf_sha256, status DRAFT/FINAL, plus the forbidden-eBarimt-keys CHECK. Append-only via platform.ledger_guard with only status mutable (FINAL → DRAFT forbidden). Index (company_id, report_code, fiscal_year, created_at DESC). Becomes a document_signature target.
reason: BR-RPT-90…93. FR-RPT-012 AC1 requires a saved report to reopen with the old template version and the same numbers. Also needed for Form A director/chief-accountant signatures, e-balance evidence and the archive package.

change: SCR-RPT-04: Add gl.accounting_period_status_log.checklist_snapshot jsonb, with a CHECK that it is NULL or a JSON object.
reason: BR-PER-44. FR-GL-025 AC1 requires closing with warnings to record the user, the reason and the checklist state; there is no other place to store the checklist result.

change: SCR-RPT-05: Add rpt.cash_flow_category.reverse_category_id (self-FK). Seed the pairs FIN_BORROWINGS↔FIN_LOAN_REPAYMENTS, INV_LOANS_GIVEN↔INV_LOANS_REPAID, FIN_SHARES_ISSUED↔FIN_SHARE_BUYBACK, INV_FA_BUY↔INV_FA_SALE, INV_INTANGIBLE_BUY↔INV_INTANGIBLE_SALE, INV_INVESTMENT_BUY↔INV_INVESTMENT_SALE.
reason: BR-RPT-77 and seed §12 #4. For two-direction accounts (loans 2400/2700, loans granted 1370), flows against the category's direction would go to the reverse line automatically.

change: SCR-RPT-06: Add rpt.fin_report_row.rounding_anchor boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false. In the seed set it true for SBT 1.3 and 2.3, ODT 22 and 24, all OOT *.9 rows, and MGT 5 and 7.
reason: BR-EBL-04. Anchor rows for the round-then-sum thousand-MNT logic are hard-coded in R1; editable report definitions (R2) need them as data.

change: SCR-RPT-07: Add two rows to integration.job_definition. 'gl.fiscal_year.ensure_next': PER_COMPANY, cron '0 0 18 30 11 ?' (1 Dec 02:00 Ulaanbaatar time), max_attempts 3. 'rpt.filing_deadline_reminder': PER_COMPANY, cron '0 0 1 * 1,2 ?' (daily 09:00 Ulaanbaatar time in January–February), max_attempts 3.
reason: BR-PER-02 and BR-EBL-09. FR-GL-022 AC1 requires the next year to exist in advance; CMP-009 needs a reminder of the 10 February e-balance deadline.

change: SCR-RPT-08 (conditional): projection table gl.account_period_balance (company, account, period, is_closing, dim1, dim2, net, debit, credit), upserted by the posting engine.
reason: BR-RPT-50. Only needed if NFR-014 (trial balance under 2 s) is missed for companies with many years of history.

change: SCR-RPT-09: In 910_ledger_guards.sql gl.fn_accounting_period_status(), refuse LOCKED on a December period (ERP02) unless the fiscal year is CLOSED and closing_transaction_no IS NOT NULL. Ship in the same migration as 13 CR-24.
reason: BR-PER-16. A second line of defence in the database: a December period locked before the year-end close would block the closing voucher.

change: SCR-RPT-10: Change the ix_gl_entry__transaction index to (company_id, transaction_no, entry_no) INCLUDE (amount, gl_account_id).
reason: Spec §5.8. Allows index-only scans for the G/L detail contra-account lookup and for the cash-flow contra classification.

change: SCR-RPT-11: Published views sales.v_draft_document, purchase.v_draft_document and bank.v_draft_document (company_id, document_type, posting_date, count), with security_invoker and GRANT SELECT.
reason: BR-PER-37 (the DRAFTS_IN_PERIOD checklist item). Under 02 §4.3 rule 2, Reporting may read other modules only through published v_* views.

change: SCR-RPT-12: Add a CHECK on rpt.fin_report_row: totaling_type <> 'CASH_FLOW_CATEGORY' OR row_type = 'NET_CHANGE'.
reason: BR-RPT-49. Cash-flow rows only make sense as net change over a range.

change: SCR-RPT-01 (revised): DROP FUNCTION rpt.fn_trial_balance(date, date, boolean) before creating rpt.fn_trial_balance(p_from, p_to, p_include_closing, p_dim1 uuid DEFAULT NULL, p_dim2 uuid DEFAULT NULL) with BC C-date semantics (opening includes all earlier closing entries; p_include_closing only affects closing entries dated p_to); GRANT EXECUTE to app_user, app_readonly.
reason: Current function zeroes P&L opening from FYS and drops all closing entries (wrong opening balances, GS-CLOSE-004/SCR-T01); CREATE OR REPLACE with extra args would create an ambiguous overload.

change: SCR-RPT-02: new rpt.filing_submission (fiscal_year_id, filing_type EBALANCE_ANNUAL/EBALANCE_HALFYEAR, submitted_at, submitted_by, submission_reference, evidence_attachment_id, evidence_note, snapshot_ids uuid[], UNIQUE (company_id, fiscal_year_id, filing_type), evidence CHECK), append-only via platform.ledger_guard, RLS.
reason: BR-PER-17/BR-EBL-10: year LOCKED requires stored e-balance submission evidence (FR-GL-024, REQ-ACC-12); table missing from schema.

change: SCR-RPT-03 (revised): new rpt.statement_snapshot with uuid PK plus snapshot_no bigint NOT NULL (company counter, UNIQUE (company_id, snapshot_no)) used as platform.ledger_guard key_column with mutable_columns = {status}; dedicated BEFORE UPDATE trigger forbidding FINAL -> DRAFT; result jsonb, result_sha256, definition_sha256, statement_line_version, pdf_sha256, CHECK no forbidden eBarimt keys.
reason: BR-RPT-90..93, FR-RPT-012 AC1, Form A signatures and archive; platform.fn_ledger_update only accepts a bigint key, and the generic immutable guard does not block FINAL -> DRAFT.

change: SCR-RPT-04: add checklist_snapshot jsonb (object CHECK) to gl.accounting_period_status_log.
reason: BR-PER-44, FR-GL-025 AC1: warnings-acknowledged close must persist the checklist result with user and reason.

change: SCR-RPT-09 (revised): in gl.fn_accounting_period_status(): (a) LOCKED for month 12 requires fiscal_year.status = 'CLOSED' (do not require closing_transaction_no, voucherless close is valid); (b) CLOSED -> OPEN is rejected with ERP02 when the same fiscal year's December period is LOCKED.
reason: BR-PER-16 second line of defense; prevents the year-end deadlock where a reopened year can never be re-closed because December is LOCKED.

change: SCR-RPT-05: rpt.cash_flow_category.reverse_category_id (self FK) with seed pairs (FIN_BORROWINGS<->FIN_LOAN_REPAYMENTS, INV_LOANS_GIVEN<->INV_LOANS_REPAID, etc.).
reason: BR-RPT-77: two-directional accounts (loans) in direct-method МГТ without per-entry override (R2).

change: SCR-RPT-06: rpt.fin_report_row.rounding_anchor boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false; seed SBT 1.3, 2.3; ODT 22, 24; OOT *.9; MGT 5, 7.
reason: BR-EBL-04: e-balance round-then-sum anchors as data instead of code (needed once definitions are editable).

change: SCR-RPT-07: integration.job_definition rows gl.fiscal_year.ensure_next (PER_COMPANY, Dec 1 02:00 UB) and rpt.filing_deadline_reminder (PER_COMPANY, daily 09:00 UB in Jan-Feb).
reason: BR-PER-02 (next year always pre-created, FR-GL-022 AC1), BR-EBL-09 (CMP-009 deadline reminder).

change: SCR-RPT-08 (conditional): gl.account_period_balance projection (account, period, is_closing, dim1, dim2, net, debit, credit) maintained by the posting engine.
reason: Only if NFR-014 trial balance p95 <= 2 s cannot be met with ix_gl_entry__account_date.

change: SCR-RPT-10: ix_gl_entry__transaction INCLUDE (amount, gl_account_id).
reason: Index-only scans for GL contra-account and МГТ classification (§5.8).

change: SCR-RPT-11: published views sales.v_draft_document, purchase.v_draft_document, bank.v_draft_document (security_invoker, GRANT SELECT).
reason: BR-PER-37 DRAFTS_IN_PERIOD; Reporting may only read published v_* views (02 §4.3).

change: SCR-RPT-12: CHECK (totaling_type <> 'CASH_FLOW_CATEGORY' OR row_type = 'NET_CHANGE') on rpt.fin_report_row.
reason: BR-RPT-49: cash-flow category rows are only meaningful as net change.
